summary: A full-screen effect over the player's view: frozen, burning, knocked down, poisoned, or a custom picture (a logo). One per player.

panels.doc: The effect. Author it with class `hidden`. `fx-<name>` (OverlayEffects) picks the look: the stylesheets style the pool inside it, panels `.ov-fx-l0`..`.ov-fx-l7` (layers) and `.ov-fx-p.p0`..`.p39` (particles), collapsed unless the effect uses them.
